The Falklands, to call them by their proper name, are British. There is no longer a discussion worth having. The inhabitants had a referendum in 2013 and 99% want it to remain British.

And why wouldn't they?

They have the highest income/GDP in the entire southern hemisphere, stability, quality of life and secure arrangements in terms of imports and exports.

Meanwhile, in Argentina, one third of the population lives in poverty. Democracy has been suspended many times and inflation spiralling out of control is a regular occurrence.

The thought of becoming Argentine would terrify any normal people given those circumstances.

This is no criticism of the Argentinian people, more their despicable rulers who have presided over a series of terrible economic policies which has turned a prosperous country into a dysfunctional one.

The likes of Peron, the previous Juntas and the idiot in charge now talk about the Falklands as a distraction from their own failings.

The people of Argentina deserve better than the desperate nationalism they are being served.
